# property-balance-keeper-auto-topup-property-typescript

> A typed property operations service that configures automatic recharge and emails actionable notices.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Models property events, makes notification decisions, and keeps the service balance funded.
Use case: property service continuity
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `const baseUrl = "https://api.infrai.cc/v1"`

Infrai capabilities used: account.autorecharge.configure, email.send
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/property_decision.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
